Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Calcium lactate is used as a firming agent in food. Its technological role is to help maintain firmness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, jam jellies and marmalades and similar products, other similar fruit or vegetable spreads, bread prepared solely with the following ingredients: wheat flour, water, yeast or leaven,  salt. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
